title: Enclosure Requirements in Subdistrict E
previewText: In Subdistrict E, commercial and manufacturing activities and storage uses shall not be subject to the provisions of Section 42-51 (Enclosure of Commercial and Manufacturing Activities) or Section 42-52 (Enclosure or Screening of Storage).
